label: Lab 08
title: Can an agent fix a red build?
question: Handed fresh red builds it has never seen, does the agent space's CI doctor make a fix a reviewer would call real?
how: A held-out set of red builds, frozen before the doctor ran, each answer judged by two separate AI reviewers. A recount of the committed verdicts.
status: An honest negative · record cited by hash
